## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长百分比及计算过程

**计算结果：同比增长 32%（GAAP），31%（恒定汇率）**

| 项目 | FY26 Q4 (截至2026/6/30) | FY25 Q4 (截至2025/6/30) | 同比增长 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 百万 | $29,878 百万 | **32%** |

**计算过程**：
- 增长额 = 39,306 − 29,878 = 9,428 百万美元
- 增长率 = 9,428 ÷ 29,878 ≈ 31.55% ≈ **32%**（按微软 GAAP 口径四舍五入）
- 恒定汇率口径：扣除汇率影响 $80 百万后，可比增长 = (39,306 − 80 − 29,878) ÷ 29,878 ≈ 31%

**出处**：
- `financial_statements.txt` 第 18895 字符处：表格列示 "Intelligent Cloud | $39,306 | $29,878 | 32% | $80 | 31%"
- `press_release.txt` 第 3115 字符处："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"
- `transcript.txt` 第 24808 / 24908 字符处：Amy Hood 陈述 "Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency"

---

### 2. 管理层在财报电话会上对增长的归因

以下为 Amy Hood 在 `transcript.txt` 第 24908–25283 字符处（即"Intelligent Cloud segment"段落）的原话：

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet** as well as **process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity**. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value**."

此外，在 Q&A 中 Amy Hood 进一步补充了"效率提升"的细节（`transcript.txt` 第 40776–40828 字符）：

> "the first thing we focus on … is efficiency, being able to get more out of everything that we've got in the fleet. That applies to efficiency gains in the CPU fleet. It's going to be efficiency gains in the GPU fleet. We saw a good work this quarter, in particular, from our engineering teams to make as much of that available as we could. And because of the supply demand imbalance we've been talking about, when we can make efficiency gains, they are quickly monetized in quarter."

**归因汇总**：
1. **Azure 需求持续超过供给**（"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"）
2. **CPU 与 GPU 集群的效率提升（efficiency gains across CPU and GPU fleet）**
3. **流程改进使新产能更早交付（process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity），并在当季快速变现**
4. **GitHub Copilot 消费超预期**——6 月商业模式调整（改为按使用量定价）后带动消费增长

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述 逐条标注

| # | 归因 | 性质 | 判断依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Azure 需求持续超过供给（"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"） | **已发生的事实** | 这是 Amy Hood 对本季度（Q4）经营状况的回顾性描述，使用 "continues" 表明截至本季度末的状态；Q&A 中她再次确认 "that certainly remains true"（`transcript.txt` 第 39856–40828 字符），是对当前状态的陈述。 |
| 2 | CPU 与 GPU 集群的效率提升（"efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet"） | **已发生的事实** | Amy Hood 用过去时态描述本季度表现："Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains…"；Q&A 中明确说 "We saw a good work this quarter…"——"this quarter" 表明是本季度已经完成的工作（`transcript.txt` 第 40828 字符）。 |
| 3 | 流程改进使新产能更早交付并在当季变现（"process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity … quickly monetized"） | **已发生的事实** | "was quickly monetized" 是过去完成时态，指本季度已经发生的变现结果；Amy Hood 在 Q&A 中也确认这些改进 "again, are very quickly monetized" 是指本季度的实际效果（`transcript.txt` 第 41072 字符）。 |
| 4 | GitHub Copilot 消费超预期（"stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption"） | **已发生的事实** | "Results also benefited from…" 是回顾性陈述，指本季度已实现的业绩贡献；且变化发生在 "June business model change"，是已落地的政策调整。 |
| 5 | "需求继续超过供给" 的延续及 "H1 增长加速" | **前瞻性表述** | 在展望 Q1 时，Amy Hood 说："we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply. Even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate."（`transcript.txt` 第 32535–32951 字符）其中 "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" 明确使用了 "expect"，是对未来财季的预测。 |
| 6 | "efficiency gains … help us bridge the gaps" | **前瞻性表述** | 语境为面向 Q1 的展望，Amy Hood 用 "remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see" 表达的是管理层对未来的工作方向与预期，属于前瞻性承诺，而非对本季度的总结。 |

**区分总结**：
- **已发生事实（4 条）**：均为回顾性陈述，使用过去时态（was, grew, benefited, saw）或对当前状态的描述（continues），指向 FY26 Q4 已实现的业绩。
- **前瞻性表述（2 条）**：出现在展望 Q1 / H1 的段落，包含 "we expect"、"remain focused on"、"continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" 等典型前瞻性措辞，依据是管理层在财报电话会"outlook"部分（`transcript.txt` 第 32535 字符之后）使用将来时态和预测性语言。

**关键区分技巧**：
- 时态：过去时 → 事实；将来/预测性动词（expect, anticipate, remain focused on）→ 前瞻。
- 段落位置：回顾段（"Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment…"）→ 事实；展望段（"Now, to the outlook for our first quarter…"）→ 前瞻。

---

**结论**：FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 收入 $39.3B，同比增长 32%，主要归因于 Azure 需求超过供给、CPU/GPU 效率提升、新产能流程改进以及 GitHub Copilot 商业模式调整。前 4 项为已实现事实，后 2 项（需求延续 + H1 加速预期）为管理层前瞻性表述。
